standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies hom of the qc category with sheaf Hom under flat base change.

core_obligations: Write the sheaf identity $f^*\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{Y}}(\mathcal{G}, \mathcal{H}) = \mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{X}}(f^*\mathcal{G}, f^*\mathcal{H})$ via the cited sites lemma (proof lines 2028-2032).

Transport through Q: since f is flat, apply the flatness lemma identifying hom in $\mathit{QCoh}^{fbc}(\mathcal{O}_\mathcal{X})$ with the sheaf Hom, and conclude the internal-hom compatibility in the qc category (proof lines 2034-2037).
proof_roadmap: Cite the sheaf-level pullback identity for internal hom.
Use flatness to transfer the identity to hom in the qc category.
difficulty_reason: Two-step composition: the internal-hom pullback identity for sheaves on sites is cited, then the same compatibility for the hom of the QCoh^{fbc} category follows from the flatness lemma; the proof also records exactly where flatness of f is used (so that pullback by f of Hom is the sheaf Hom, while hom of the qc category needs f flat).
